US Fed Survey Indicates Rising Price Pressures

A survey by the U.S. Federal Reserve indicates that price pressures are intensifying, with rising fuel costs contributing to the trend. The Beige Book report, which compiles anecdotal evidence on economic conditions across the country, suggests that inflation may be accelerating.
